title: Spring Into Summer
excerpt: Spring has officially sprung, the days are getting longer, and there’s that little feeling in the air that summer is just around the corner.
body:
Spring Into Summer: Your Next Girls Getaway Starts Here

Spring has officially sprung, the days are getting longer, and there’s that little feeling in the air that summer is just around the corner.

Which can only mean one thing…

It’s time to start planning your next Girls Getaway.

After months of winter hibernation, we’re ready for sunshine, long lunches, poolside moments, beautiful places and, most importantly, time together.

Whether your idea of the perfect escape is a massage followed by a mimosa, a leisurely weekend in the Hunter Valley or a little coastal pampering, we’ve rounded up five of our favourite ways to Spring into Summer with the girls.

Because the best kind of summer plans are the ones you make together.

Hacienda Haven - Central Coast

For the girls who love:

  • Champagne with a side of sunshine

  • Coastal luxe and beautiful interiors

  • The beach just a stroll away

  • Bottomless brunch with a side of “just one more Aperol”

  • Feeling like you’ve escaped to a Mediterranean villa without the long-haul flight

Hacienda Haven is bringing serious coastal summer escape energy to the Central Coast.

Think two nights in your own three bedroom Hacienda, complete with coastal luxe furnishings, a spacious outdoor terrace and the beach right on your doorstep. Add a short stroll to cafés, shops and restaurants and you’ve got the perfect setting for a seriously fabulous girls’ getaway.

Arrive to a delicious grazing box loaded with cheeses, meats, dips, nuts, pâté and crackers — because no girls’ weekend should begin without snacks.

Then it’s time for the main event…

A 2 hour Italian style Bottomless Brunch, complete with delicious share dishes and two hours of free flowing classic Margaritas, Tommy’s Margaritas or Aperol Spritz.

Basically, lunch plans have never looked so good.

…. and because we believe there’s always room for a little extra indulgence, you can add on a cocktail jug and small plates at Margarita Daze, Umina’s waterfront cocktail bar, or settle in for a 2 course lunch at The Box, where you can dine right on the water.

Feeling like you need a little more me time? Add a 30 or 60 minute massage and let the holiday mode fully kick in.

It’s coastal. It’s delicious. It’s effortlessly luxe.

And it’s the kind of weekend where someone inevitably says:

"Should we just stay another night?"

Perfect for:

  • Girls’ weekends with a coastal luxe twist

  • Birthdays and special celebrations

  • Mums who deserve a proper escape

  • The friendship group who loves good food, cocktails and a little pampering

  • Anyone who thinks a 2 hour bottomless brunch is an excellent life choice

Massages & Mimosas - Port Stephens

For the girls who love:

  • A massage before a mimosa

  • Poolside resort vibes

  • Two hours of bottomless mimosas

  • Sea views and sunshine

  • A girls’ weekend where the only hard decision is massage or facial

Massages & Mimosas is bringing the ultimate girls’ escape to beautiful Nelson Bay.

Think two nights in your own contemporary 2 or 3 bedroom apartment, with resort, pool or water views, a heated swimming pool with cascading waterfall, spa, all just a short stroll from the cafés, restaurants and boutique shops of Nelson Bay.

Basically, everything you need for a fabulous weekend is right on your doorstep.

First things first… pamper time.

Settle into the comfort of your resort room for a 30 minute treatment and choose between a relaxing massage or a refreshing facial. Because sometimes you need to arrive, put your robe on and immediately forget about your inbox.

Then it’s time for the main event…

Two hours of gourmet grazing with bottomless mimosas in Nelson Bay, surrounded by stunning marina and bay views.

Good food. Gorgeous views. Bottomless mimosas.

We really don’t think we need to say much more.

When you’re not grazing or getting pampered, wander Nelson Bay for a little boutique shopping, discover the local cafés and bars or simply make the most of your resort facilities.

Feeling adventurous? Head up to Tomaree Summit Lookout for breathtaking views across Port Stephens and yes, the photo opportunity is absolutely worth the climb.

And if you’re not quite ready for the fun to end, add on a banquet dinner at a fabulous seaside restaurant for the perfect night out with the girls.

It’s relaxing. It’s social. It’s a little bit indulgent.

And it’s the kind of weekend where someone inevitably says:

"Mimosas are basically fruit juice, right?"

Perfect for:

  • BFF weekends that need a little pampering

  • Birthdays and celebrations

  • Mums who deserve some serious girl time

  • The friendship group who loves a resort, a massage and a cocktail

  • Anyone who believes bottomless mimosas are an essential part of a balanced lifestyle

Grazing & Lazing - Hunter Valley

For the girls who love:

  • Wine without the designated driver

  • Lazy mornings and late checkouts

  • Grazing platters on the balcony

  • High Tea with a view

  • Having absolutely nowhere to be

Grazing & Lazing is our newest Hunter Valley escape, it’s all about slowing down, settling in and enjoying some seriously good girl time.

Think two nights in a beautiful 2 or 3 bedroom villa, surrounded by nature and the gorgeous Hunter Valley landscape. Your resort has everything you need for a weekend of relaxation, including pools, a jacuzzi, two restaurants, a bar and even a bottle shop.

So, technically, you could arrive on Friday and never leave.

And honestly? We’re very okay with that.

Start your getaway with a delicious grazing platter filled with fresh local produce and cheeses, perfect for enjoying from your villa balcony while taking in the valley views. Wake up slowly the next morning and make your way to a full hot buffet breakfast, because breakfast tastes even better when someone else is cooking.

Then comes Sunday’s pièce de résistance…

High Tea overlooking the lake and beautiful resort surrounds.

Because nothing says girls’ weekend quite like tea, treats, plenty of chatting and absolutely no rush.

And with a 2PM late checkout, you can enjoy those last few precious hours with the girls before reality calls.

Want to take the relaxation up a notch? Add a Day Spa experience, complete with a massage or facial, mineral pools and recovery lounge. Or keep the pampering in the villa with an in accommodation massage or facial.

And for the ultimate Hunter Valley experience, gather four or more girls and add an in villa wine tasting.

It’s relaxed. It’s indulgent. It’s deliciously lazy.

And it’s the kind of weekend where someone inevitably says:

"Do we actually have to leave?"

Perfect for:

  • Bestie weekends with nowhere to be

  • Mums who need a proper switch off

  • Birthdays and celebrations

  • Wine loving friendship groups

  • The girls who think a late checkout should be standard everywhere

  • Anyone whose ideal Hunter Valley itinerary is graze, sip, relax, repeat

Pamper In Paradise - Mooloolaba

For the girls who love:

  • Sunshine and sea breezes

  • A little pampering with their prosecco

  • Grazing platters delivered straight to the door

  • Poolside catchups and alfresco afternoons

  • Saying “Ooh la la” because you’re in Mooloolaba

Pamper in Paradise is your excuse to escape to the Sunshine Coast and indulge in some seriously good girl time by the sea.

Think two nights in your own three bedroom house, just one block from the main street and ocean. There’s space to spread out, an alfresco area made for long chats and, most importantly, nowhere you need to be in a hurry.

Arrive, unpack and let the holiday mode begin.

Your delicious grazing platter will be delivered straight to your door, so you can settle in, pour yourself something lovely and start catching up with the girls without even leaving the house.

Then it’s time to pamper in paradise.

Enjoy a 30 minute facial or massage in the comfort of your accommodation, with your trained beauty therapist bringing the relaxation straight to you.

Because sometimes the best spa is the one that comes to your holiday house.

And when you’re ready to venture out, Mooloolaba is right there waiting.

Upgrade your pamper to a full hour, set sail on a seafood lunch cruise, watch the sun go down on a sunset cruise or gather the girls for a cocktail class where you’ll learn to shake, stir and strain three timeless classics.

Basically, you can make this getaway as relaxed or as “let’s have another cocktail” as you like.

It’s sunny. It’s coastal. It’s seriously relaxing.

And it’s the kind of weekend where someone inevitably says:

"Why don't we do this every year?"

Perfect for:

  • Girls’ weekends with serious holiday vibes

  • Birthdays and special celebrations

  • Mums who need a little sunshine and selfcare

  • Beach loving besties

  • The friendship group who believes every good getaway needs a massage & cocktails

Blairgowrie Bliss - Mornington Peninsula

For the girls who love:

  • Ocean views and beautiful beach houses

  • A Negroni waiting when they arrive

  • Local treats and grazing platters

  • Long, lazy days at a luxury thermal spa

  • A getaway that feels effortlessly chic

Blairgowrie Bliss is bringing serious coastal-luxe energy to the Mornington Peninsula.

Think two nights in a gorgeous boutique beach house with ocean views, complete with three bedrooms, three bathrooms, custom furniture, an equipped kitchen, indoor and outdoor bathtubs, multiple outdoor entertaining spaces and even a fire pit.

Basically, this is the kind of house that makes you want to cancel everything else.

Arrive to a complimentary Negroni jug and a beautiful welcome hamper filled with local goodies, fresh artisan bread or crumpets, homemade muesli, seasonal fruit, sparkling water, Tyrrells Crisps, Hunted+Gathered chocolate and homemade jam.

And because we believe every great arrival deserves a little grazing, your delicious grazing platter will be waiting too, packed with seasonal fruits, cheeses, dips, crackers, cured meats and more.

But the real bliss begins at Alba Thermal Springs.

Spend the day soaking, floating and completely switching off with all day access to 22 geothermal pools, plus the sauna and steam room. Your experience also includes a locker, towel and bathrobe hire, so all you need to bring is yourself — and perhaps the girls.

Then choose your perfect way to finish the day:

A two course meal at Thyme Restaurant, including a glass of Peninsula wine or local craft beer…

Or go full afternoon indulgence with High Tea, your choice of teas and an Alba Springs cocktail, plus their signature herbal tea to take home.

It’s coastal. It’s sophisticated. It’s wonderfully indulgent.

And it’s the kind of weekend where someone inevitably says:

"I think we should make this our annual girls' trip."

Perfect for:

  • Girls’ weekends with a little luxury

  • Birthdays and milestone celebrations

  • Mums who deserve some serious R&R

  • Foodie friendship groups

  • The girls who believe a thermal pool, a Negroni and a grazing platter are the perfect combination

So… where will you Spring into Summer?

Whether it’s a weekend with your besties, a school mums' escape, a birthday celebration or simply a long-overdue catch-up…

There’s always a good reason to get the girls together.

And we think spring is a pretty great one. 💕

Ready To Plan Your Spring or Summer Getaway?

Whether you're enjoying the serenity of the Blairgowrie, sipping wine in the Hunter or coastal calm at Hacienda, we've already done the hard work.

All you need to do is pick a date, send it to the group chat and prepare for 47 messages saying:

"I'm easy with whatever everyone wants to do." 🙃

  • Hacienda Haven NSW

  • Massages & Mimosas NSW

  • Grazing & Lazing NSW

  • Pamper In Paradise QLD

  • Blairgowrie Bliss VIC

title: Cool-cations are in..
excerpt: Move over Euro summer.
body:
Why Winter Is The Ultimate Time For A Girls Getaway

Move over Euro summer.

This year we're embracing something a little slower, a little cosier and a whole lot more fabulous.

Introducing the era of the Cool-Cation where your biggest decision is red wine or margarita, dressing gown or oversized knit, wine tasting or long lunch.

Winter is honestly one of our favourite times to escape. The crowds disappear, the fireplaces come alive, the wine somehow tastes better and suddenly nobody feels guilty about spending an entire afternoon chatting beside a fire with a grazing platter.

If your group chat has been threatening to organise a girls weekend for the last 18 months, consider this your sign.

Hamptons In The Hunter

For the girls who love:

  • Champagne before noon

  • Beautiful gardens

  • Luxury stays

  • Pretending they're in the Hamptons without the 24-hour flight

Our newest Hunter Valley package is giving serious main character energy. Think glamorous accommodation, rolling vineyards, cocktail classes and long afternoons sipping wine while someone else organises literally everything. The package includes a choice of a half-day wine tour or luxury high tea, plus optional cocktail making classes and pamper treatments.

It's sophisticated. It's fabulous. It's the kind of weekend where everyone suddenly starts saying things like:

"Let's order another bottle."

Perfect for:

  • Birthdays

  • Mums weekends away

  • The friendship group that loves a little luxury

Moonlighting In Mudgee

If your dream weekend involves:

  • Fire pits

  • Slow & cosy in house cinema days

  • Red wine

  • Late-night chats under fairy lights

Then hello Mudgee.

This private retreat is basically winter girls getaway heaven. Sparkling pool, spa, sauna, fire pit, outdoor lounges and enough cosy corners to disappear with a wine and solve the world's problems.

Days are spent winery hopping and exploring local favourites.

Nights?

That's when the magic happens.

Matching pyjamas. Cheese boards. Questionable dance moves. Deep life chats. Somebody crying laughing.

The usual.

Perfect for:

  • Friendship reunions

  • School mum weekends

  • Girls who want equal parts relaxation and chaos

Something In The Orange

Orange in winter is criminally underrated.

Cool-climate wines.
Cosy wine bars.
Long lunches.
Open fireplaces.
Country charm.

Honestly? It's the kind of place that makes you immediately start looking at real estate listings after your second winery.

Our Something In The Orange package combines winery experiences, incredible food and plenty of downtime to explore the boutiques, bars and gorgeous streets that make Orange such a favourite girls getaway destination.

Pack your boots.
Pack your oversized coat.
Pack your appetite.

You're going to need all three.

Perfect for:

  • Foodies

  • Wine lovers

  • The group chat that accidentally books every meal around wine

Why Winter Weekends Hit Different

Summer girls trips are fabulous.

But winter girls trips?

They're elite.

They're slower.
Cosier.
Less rushed.

Nobody's trying to squeeze into a bikini & you dont need a pedicure because your ugg boots are essential.

Everybody's happy sitting around a fireplace with a glass of red discussing absolutely nothing and absolutely everything.

And honestly, that's kind of the point.

Because sometimes the best weekends aren't about ticking off activities.

They're about finally getting your favourite people in the same room.

title: Personalities on a Girls trip..
excerpt: You’ve said it. You’ve thought it. You’ve probably even typed it into the group chat at least 14 times this year…
body:
Every Girl Group Has One… Which One Are You?

You’ve said it.
You’ve thought it.
You’ve probably even typed it into the group chat at least 14 times this year…

“We should book a girls weekend.”

And somehow… between work, kids, life and “I’ll check my calendar,” it never quite happens.

Until one day… it does.

Dates are locked.
The group chat is popping off.
The outfits are already being mentally planned.

But let’s be honest — the real wildcard of any girls getaway?

The personalities in the group chat.

Because every trip has its characters. And every group? Identical structure. No exceptions.

So… which one are you?

The Organiser - (aka the reason the trip is actually happening)

Booked it.
Paid the deposit first.
Created the group chat.
Sent 3 destination options.
Followed up… twice… then again with a “just circling back on this” message.

You’ve already:

  • Checked cancellation policies

  • Compared 4 different packages

  • Mentally built a run sheet

Without you?
This trip would still be sitting in the “we should totally do something” phase.

Honestly… you deserve a free cocktail on arrival.

The “I’m Easy” Girl (but… is she though?)

“Whatever you guys want!”
“I’m so easy!”
“I’ll go with the flow!”

We love the energy. We do.

But then…

Everything gets booked and suddenly:

  • “I don’t really love that area…”

  • “I’m not huge on wine tours…”

  • “Could we maybe do something more chill?”

Ahhh yes. The plot twist.

The Late Canceller (every group has one…)

She was in.
She was excited.
She reacted with a 🔥 to the booking message.

Then out of nowhere…

“Work is crazy”
“Something’s come up”
“I can’t make it anymore 😭”

Timing?
Always within 48 hours of check-in

And suddenly everyone’s:

  • Reworking rooms

  • Adjusting costs

  • Pretending they’re totally fine about it

(It’s fine. We’re fine.)

The Overpacker (prepared for every possible scenario)

Weather forecast? Checked.
Backup weather forecast? Also checked.

Brings:

  • 3 outfits per day

  • “Just in case” outfits

  • Heels that will not be worn

  • A full skincare routine

  • 3 different chargers and a portable charger - we need content

Suitcase = full
Carry on = also full

And still…

“I feel like I forgot something.”

The Party Captain (no regrets, just vibes)

First one ready.
Last one standing.
Orders the shots.
Finds the dance floor.

Responsible for:

  • “Just one more”

  • Turning dinner into a night out

  • Everyone losing track of time

Voice? Gone by Sunday.
Memories? Questionable.
Energy? Elite. The unofficial leader of weekend vibes and why you have a hangover

The Wellness Girlie (balance… apparently)

Booked:

  • Pilates at 7am

  • A coastal walk

  • A “slow morning moment”

Also:

  • Had espresso martinis at midnight

  • Ate snacks in bed

  • Still somehow thriving

“Hydrate girls” — while holding a margarita.

So… which one are you?

The Real Truth?

Every group has all of these.

And if you’re reading this thinking
“we don’t have a canceller…”

…I’ve got news for you.

Why This Is Exactly Why You Need the Trip

Because between the chaos, the group chat debates, the outfit changes and the slightly questionable decisions…

this is the stuff you actually remember.

Not the perfect plan.
Not the schedule.

But:

  • Laughing until you cry

  • Getting ready together

  • The “how is it 2am?” moments

  • The chats you don’t get time for at home

So… which one are you?

Or better yet…

Send this to the group chat and assign the roles.

(We guarantee there will be disagreements on who they are)

Ready to actually book it this time?

Lucky for you…

We’ve already done the organising

Browse our curated getaways at Girls Getaways, pick a date, and lock it in.

Because if you don’t…

The Organiser will.

title: The Importance Of A Girls Getaways…And Why We All Need One.
excerpt: In the chaos of everyday life — work deadlines, family commitments, school runs, emotional labour, and the constant pull to “do it all” — women are often the last ones to put themselves first.
body:
The Importance Of A Girls Getaways..And Why We All Need One.

In the chaos of everyday life — work deadlines, family commitments, school runs, emotional labour, and the constant pull to “do it all” — women are often the last ones to put themselves first.

That’s exactly why a Girls Getaway isn’t a luxury.
It’s a reset. A reconnection. And in many cases, a necessity.

Pack your bags - adventure awaits!

It’s More Than a Trip — It’s Time to Breathe

A girls getaway creates space.
Space away from routine. Space away from responsibility. Space to exhale.

When women step out of their everyday roles — mum, partner, employee, carer, organiser — something powerful happens. They remember who they are outside of what they do for others.

And that space? It’s where rest actually begins.

Reconnecting With Your People Matters

Friendships change as life gets busier. Catch-ups become rushed coffees. Group chats replace real conversations. Years slip by faster than we expect.

A girls getaway presses pause.

It brings women back together — uninterrupted, unfiltered, and present. Long lunches turn into late-night chats. Laughter comes easily. Conversations go deeper. Bonds strengthen.

These shared experiences don’t just feel good in the moment — they become the memories that carry you through life’s busy seasons.

The Mental Health Benefits Are Real

Time away with trusted friends reduces stress, boosts mood, and helps regulate burnout. Studies consistently show that strong social connections improve mental wellbeing, and there’s something uniquely therapeutic about time spent with women who get you.

A girls getaway allows:

  • Emotional release

  • Perspective shifts

  • Reduced anxiety

  • A sense of belonging

And sometimes, it’s simply the permission to rest without guilt.

Celebrating Life’s Milestones — Big and Small

Not every girls getaway needs a reason, but they’re especially meaningful when tied to life moments.

Birthdays. Hens weekends. Divorce celebrations. Empty nest chapters. Career milestones. Or simply “we haven’t done this in years.”

At Girls Getaways, we see firsthand how powerful it is when women intentionally mark moments in their lives — not with more “stuff”, but with shared experiences.

Why Curated Matters

Organising a group trip can be overwhelming. Different budgets, expectations, schedules, personalities, it’s often easier to not plan anything at all.

That’s where a curated girls getaway changes everything.

When the details are handled for you, accommodation, experiences, dining, pampering, logistics — the group can focus on what actually matters: being together.

No spreadsheets. No stress. No decision fatigue.

Just arrival, relaxation, and connection.

You Deserve This Time

So many women delay joy. Delay rest. Delay time with friends.

But the truth is, there will always be another commitment, another responsibility, another reason to put it off.

A girls getaway is a reminder that you matter too.

And when women return home from time away feeling lighter, happier, and more connected, everyone benefits.

Ready to Plan Your Girls Getaway?

At Girls Getaways, we specialise in luxury women’s group getaways across Australia, thoughtfully curated, beautifully styled, and completely stress free.

You bring the girls.
We’ll take care of the rest.

title: Girls Getaways on a Budget: 10 Affordable Escapes You’ll Love in 2025
excerpt: Looking for the perfect girls getaway without breaking the bank? We’ve got you covered.
body:
Girls Getaways on a Budget: 10 Affordable Escapes You’ll Love in 2025

Looking for the perfect girls getaway without breaking the bank? We’ve got you covered.

It's easier than ever to plan a fun, memorable trip that won’t drain your wallet. From sunny beaches to charming cities and country escapes, we’ve rounded up 10 of our best budget-friendly getaways for you and your friends to explore. Whether you’re celebrating a birthday, special milestone, hens weekend, or planning a trip “just because”, you won’t want to miss these 10 affordable getaways for your next girls trip.

Pack your bags - adventure awaits!

1. CLAY DATES & BEACH BREAKS - GERRINGONG, SOUTH COAST NSW

Take barefoot luxury on a budget to the next level with a coastal stay with Mediterranean vibes and get your hands dirty with a creative activity!

  • Stay 2 nights in a beautifully-styled 5 bedroom beach house with spacious living areas, sun-drenched deck, in-ground heated pool and prime location just moments from Werri Beach.

  • Graze on a delicious platter delivered on arrival featuring seasonal fruits, cheeses and assorted antipasto nibbles.

  • Create at a 3hr Clay-making workshop in the convenience of your accommodation. Includes the making of 3-4 decorative pottery pieces featuring all Australian organic non toxic air dry clay, gorgeous table styling & a wooden board so you can transport your pieces home safely.

Enjoy with 8-11 girls, from $435PP.

VIEW PACKAGE

Credit: Greenhouse the Bathhouse

2. DECADENT DETOX - BURLEIGH, GOLD COAST QLD

For those looking to treat themselves and feel completely spoiled, you can’t pass up this bathhouse getaway of your dreams!

  • Stay 2 nights in a spacious ocean or pool view apartment.

  • Graze on delicious nibbles, delivered to your door on arrival.

  • Pamper yourself with a 30-minute in-house treatment in the comfort of your accommodation.

  • Soak in the hydrotherapy spas, steam room, sauna and plunge pool at Greenhouse the Bathhouse.

  • Relax with a body scrub and wholesome lunch at the bathhouse.

Ideal getaway for 3-10 girls, from $555PP.

VIEW PACKAGE

3. SECLUDED COUNTRY CHARM - MUDGEE, NSW

Go countryside with they girls at this charming farmhouse stay in the ever-popular Mudgee region, packing so much value into a 2-day escape!

  • Stay 2 nights in a beautiful 4-bedroom property with spacious entertaining areas.

  • Indulge in welcome wine and chocolates.

  • Delight in a breakfast basket.

  • Sip wine at a full-day wine tour featuring visits to 4 wineries as well as pick up and return to your accommodation.

  • Access to your very own underground private bar and ingredients to create your own cocktail

  • 5pm late check-out on Sunday.

Perfect escape for 3-8 girls, from $419PP.

VIEW PACKAGE

4. MYSTIC MOUNTAINS - BLUE MOUNTAINS, NSW

Why not spend your next budget-friendly trip with the girls in the fresh air and greenery of the mountains?

  • Stay 2 nights in the Palm Springs-inspired hotel in Blackheath, Blue Mountains.

  • Enjoy the complimentary tennis court, outdoor hot tub and sauna at your accomodation.

  • Dine at at a farm-to-table style restaurant, spotlighting regional and home-grown produce.

  • Treat yourself to a Deluxe High Tea with panoramic views overlooking the Megalong Valley.

Enjoy this bliss with 2-9 girls, from $449PP.

VIEW PACKAGE

Credit: Flotilla

5. GO WITH THE FLOW - NEWCASTLE, NSW

If you fancy a city escape that combines pampering with an indulgent dinner, then look no further than this!

  • Stay 2 nights in a spacious and contemporary apartment, centrally located in the city.

  • Unwind at a 1-hour in-house pamper treatment.

  • Taste an array of locally sourced nibbles in a grazing platter delivered to your accommodation.

  • Feast on a banquet lunch or dinner at local restaurant serving up fresh local flavours with an emphasis on Australian produce.

A city break for 3-12 girls, $349PP.

VIEW PACKAGE

6. BABES IN THE BAY - NELSON BAY, NSW

Only 3 hours from Sydney, this coastal getaway is perfect for besties looking for an affordable getaway in a seaside paradise.

  • Stay 2 nights in an apartment at a relaxed holiday resort in Nelson Bay, with a 25 meter lagoon pool, poolside recreation area featuring BBQ and spa, and a gym.

  • Graze on a platter of fresh nibbles, delivered to you on arrival.

  • Indulge in a pamper treatment in the comfort of your resort room. 30-60 minutes, depending on group size.

  • Delight in a 2-hour ‘Seaside Sparkle Sesh’ High Tea by the seaside, including a welcome shimmering Prosecco and sparkly sweet and savoury treats.

Relax in the Bay with 3-12 girls, from $465PP.

VIEW PACKAGE

7. HOME IN THE HINTERLAND - MYOCUM, BYRON BAY NSW

Get the girls ready for an affordable getaway in one of Australia’s most iconic destinations, where you will enjoy the relaxed small-town vibes of the Byron Bay Hinterland whilst being only a short drive from Byron’s town centre and sparkling beaches.

  • Stay 2 nights at a 4 bedroom farmhouse featuring a gorgeous pool overlooking the hinterland, huge entertaining deck, wraparound veranda, fireplace and outdoor fire-pit.

  • Nibble on a selection of antipasto, seasonal fruits and cheeses in a delicious grazing platter on arrival.

  • Feast on the chef’s tasting menu at The Mez Club - featuring a selection of their favourite dishes.

Perfect for 4-10 girls, from $449PP.

VIEW PACKAGE

Credit: White Rabbit Cocktail Room

8. CLASSY IN CANBERRA - CANBERRA, ACT

Take your next girls trip to Australia’s capital for an affordable getaway that is as fun as it is stylish.

  • Stay 2 nights in a 1 or 2-bedroom apartment at Burbury Hotel, Canberra.

  • Treat yourself to a sparkling High tea featuring a range of savouries and sweets and a glass of sparkling wine.

  • Enjoy a cocktail-making masterclass in Canberra’s CBD.

Ideal for 4-10 girls, from $435PP.

VIEW PACKAGE

9. FAVE FARM STAY - HUNTER VALLEY, NSW

If countryside charm without sacrificing on luxury is your affordable getaway style, then look no further than this farm stay in the stunning surrounds of the Australian countryside.

  • Stay 2 nights in a contemporary three-bedroom farm stay style property perfectly nestled between the charming townships of Paterson and Dungog in the Hunter Valley region.

  • Graze on a delicious platter box delivered to your accommodation.

  • Indulge in a three-course lunch at the boutique restaurant & cellar door, Boydell’s in the heart of Morpeth. The contemporary menu has a strong focus on locally sourced seasonal produce.

  • Delight in a Wine tasting experience at Boydell’s cellar door where you’ll be guided through a selection of six wines.

Enjoy this getaway with 3-8 girls, from $469PP.

VIEW PACKAGE

10. CHARMING VINOS & VIEWS - DAYLESFORD, VIC

If you’re looking to explore one of Victoria’s finest destinations, immerse in this tranquil village with a well-being focus, great wine and lots of explore - less that 2 hours from the exciting city of Melbourne.

  • Stay 2 nights at a 3 bedroom charming property only 10 minutes from Daylesford’s town centre. Offering a perfect blend of rustic elegance and modern comfort, it is an ideal retreat for those seeking a peaceful getaway.

title: 5 reasons you should book a country retreat for your next girls’ weekend
excerpt: ©Visit Victoria
body:
©Visit Victoria

5 reasons you should book a country retreat for your next girls’ weekend

While a getaway by the beach or traipsing around a new city is always fun, there’s just something about a weekend in the country that just hits different.

Perhaps it’s the serenity of being in an uncrowded space where the air is fresh and nature extends far beyond what the eye can see. Perhaps it’s the quietness where the only sounds are the crackle of the fire and the chatter of your friends around the fire pit. Or perhaps, it’s the warmth that a country retreat offers, paired with the company of your friends, that makes it the ultimate atmosphere for a girl's weekend.

Either way, if you’re wondering what to do for your next girls weekend, allow us to explain why we think a country retreat is the way to go:

1. The serenity

Whether escaping your kids for a weekend or celebrating an occasion, you’ll notice the serenity from the moment you arrive.

There’s truly no better way to escape from the busyness of daily life than spending a weekend where you can unwind with a drink by the fire, gaze out at green pastures from every angle and enjoy the quiet surroundings as you sip your morning coffee – this is the promise that a secluded country house offers.

2. Reconnect with nature

You know that feeling when you go on a nice walk outdoors or in nature and you immediately feel refreshed?! Well, imagine having that feeling for a whole weekend.

Research has proven that immersing yourself in green spaces can do a lot more than simply improve your mood, it can also have a direct positive impact on our physical wellbeing. So why not immerse yourself in nature by staying at a beautiful country retreat that boasts beautiful views and encourages you to appreciate the outdoors?

3. Bonus features

A bonus of escaping to the country is that it’s more feasible for holiday homes to add extra features to their properties to make them unique.

A popular feature, and favourite of ours, of course, is a fire pit. Just picture yourselves settling in on a Friday evening and tucking into a grazing platter made with local ingredients and pouring a glass of vino or whatever you fancy while catching up around the fire pit. You might even feel nostalgic enough to roast marshmallows!

Other bonus features you can find in some of our getaway packages are unique architecturally designed homes or accommodations with a private bar like our Secluded Country Charm getaway in Mudgee. Some have resident horses while others have unique trail walks and incredible pools to keep you cool in the summertime. It’s the added touches like these that make a getaway feel all the more special.

4. The Privacy

One thing that’s guaranteed to ruin the fun of a girls’ weekend is a noise complaint from the neighbours. And let’s face it, we all have that one friend who can get a little rowdy when girls’ weekend comes around!

That’s why the best solution is to simply choose accommodation where you don’t have to worry about any neighbours.

What’s great about booking a more rural property is the expansive land that it sits on meaning you often don’t have to worry about disgruntled neighbours, maybe just a few resident farm animals.

5. The Style

It’s common to think that a country getaway falls on the other end of the spectrum than a luxury getaway. But sometimes, that’s far from the truth.

Whoever said going country can’t be stylish hasn’t experienced the beauty of a gorgeously styled country home. For example, the stunning property featured in our Saddle Ridge Retreat getaway in Kangaroo Valley.

When you escape to a beautifully styled property that also has the feel of a country home, the mood just hits differently and it’s one of the best spaces for a cosy night in with the girls.

title: Welcome to Daylesford, The Spa Capital of VIC

body:
Image Credit: LakeHouse Daylesford

How to spend a weekend in Daylesford

Rich with history, healing, expansive fields, wildflowers, wineries and mountain ranges, Daylesford, just 1.5 hours north-west of Melbourne offers a beautiful destination for a girls getaway!

Long considered a special place of healing and ‘Victoria’s Spa Capital,’ the town is an oasis of calm where luxurious spa retreats, fields of lavender and charming boutique cottages are set amongst acres of fairytale rural landscapes.

Besides the town’s mineral waters and retreat-style activities, Daylesford and Hepburn also boast a great foodie hub, with an array of old-fashioned cafes, delicious restaurants with locally produced food to a multitude of fine dining options. The nature that surrounds the regional town is another aspect of its striking appeal. From national parks, botanical gardens, farms, lakes & wildlife - Daylesford really does tick all the boxes for a relaxing and enriching getaway experience.

So if you’re feeling enticed to spend a weekend in Daylesford for your next girls trip, we’ve done the research for you and designed the perfect getaway packages linked below, all paying homage to a certain part of Daylesford’s beauty.

Otherwise, read on for our guide of the best things to see and do, and the best places to eat in Daylesford.

Luxury on Lake Daylesford Mineral Baths & Lavender Farms Hillside Vinos & Views

Things to see & do in Daylesford:

When Daylesford is involved, we can’t help but talk about wellness… I mean who doesn’t love to indulge in a spa experience and treat your body?

Two of the wellness & spa facilities we include in our packages are; Hepburn Bathhouse & Spa, and The Spa at Lake House Daylesford. Knowing that Hepburn Springs & Daylesford area is home to over 100 natural mineral springs, had us look into the history and benefits of the mineral water.

Rich in magnesium, calcium and silica, among other minerals, the region's springs are believed to cure all sorts of afflictions, from acne to arthritis. By the early 1800s, the locals were aware of these health benefits and lobbied the local council to halt sluicing for gold to protect the water. That lead to the creation of the Mineral Springs Reserve in 1865 and, in 1895, the Hepburn Bathhouse was built.

The Hepburn Bathhouse and Spa is a historic spa, that has been around since 1895, is today a thoroughly modern affair, with communal bathing (swimming costumes are mandatory) in the mineral relaxation pool and salt therapy pool, as well as private tubs in the spa. The complex also includes an outdoor creekside spa pool and a Moroccan-style hammam. The Hepburn area's therapeutic mineral springs are rich in potassium, magnesium, silica and chloride. Drawing mineral-rich waters directly from the natural source, this iconic bathhouse reconnects you with an array of mineral wellness experiences including indulgent 100% pure private mineral baths and a selection of specifically designed wellness packages. The Spa at Lakehouse, using mineral waters in their treatments, has you indulging at one of the most luxury resorts in Daylesford, packaged with massage and pamper therapies to leave you feeling utterly reset.

One of the attractions that everyone raves about, is the beautiful Convent Gallery. Daylesford is a hub for art and design in Australia, and the Convent Gallery is where some of its finest displays can be found.

Nestled on a hill overlooking Daylesford and the Wombat Hill Botanical Gardens, the Convent was once a 19th-century private mansion during the Gold Rush era and has since seen lives as a convent and boarding school for girls, before its 1988 purchase and conversion into the current gallery, cafe, store, and museum.

Described as ‘the most beautiful gallery in Australia’, The Convent houses eight different exhibition spaces and features local and international artists producing art in a variety of mediums and styles. The program changes every six - eight weeks, so there’s always something new and fun to explore there. Sit down at the cafe, have a coffee or vino and take in the cultural beauty of Daylesford.

For easy access to the convent gallery, stay at Foxglove Villa in our ‘Hillside Vinos & Views’ package, as the beautiful cottage home is situated just down the road from the gallery, on the top of Wombat Hill. The Convent Gallery and it’s gardens are open from 10am till 4pm each day and costs roughly $5 to enter!

Image credit: Visit Victoria archives

Where to Eat & Drink:

We fell in love with Sault Restaurant, the lavender farm extravagance where you could happily sit and explore for an entire day. The restaurant itself is a rural France meets regional Victoria theme, featuring fresh and local produce grown from their expansive kitchen garden, offering a seasonal menu that is constantly changing. Not only can you enjoy a 3 or 7 course chef’s tasting menu here at the restaurant, they also have a beautiful array of cocktails and beverages whilst you stare out the windows at the surround lavender gardens. Talk about dreamy!!

Sault Restaurant, by Carly Yang

We also favour a local favourite, Beppe Bar & Kitchen, getting swept up into Italy with the tall leadlight windows, a striking Italian wood-fired oven, and incredible, pizzas, pastas with a modern take . The restaurant was Inspired by tradition, and pays homage to the strong Italian and general migrant communities in the Daylesford and Hepburn region. One of the incredible experiences they have is a Chef’s Table Experience, a sharing-style feast of antipasto, insalata, risotto, pasta, pizza, secondi & dolce. This isn’t one to miss.

And of course, theres the one-stop-shop that has it all, Cliffy’s Emporium. If we delved into the history of it ( because most places in Daylesford contain alot of history ) ‘Back in the 1950s, Cliffy Hauser’s general store in Daylesford was famous for an extraordinary range of produce, groceries and farm supplies crammed into a rustic timber and corrugated iron building.’ Cliffy’s has maintained it’s character and history and now operates as a homey cafe, deli shop, full of locally produced and farmed goodies. Go and pull up a stool under the verandah and grapevine shade at Cliffy’s emporium, and stock up on all things fresh and homemade.

Image Credit : Visit Victoria.

Theres so much to do in Daylesford and we know that if you choose to getaway here, not only will you be getting away with girlfriends in a stunning country town, we promise you’ll return feeling completely rejuvenated and relaxed in the Spa Capital of VIC!

Lauren

Girls Getaways xx

I am a graduate of Hotel and Restaurant Management, I really have a sweet spot when it comes to Hospitality and Culinary experiences.

This question left me smiling…I always love setting a picnic for girlfriends and family, as well as preparing snacks. This is whats at the top of my list. Bottle of wine, fruits, pizza and cheesecake!

My Family and Friends know me well, we experienced both highs and lows together. They would describe me for being empathetic, responsible and indecisive person

title: The Insider Guide to a Weekend in Newcastle
excerpt: Image Credit: laurenjaneimages
body:
Image Credit: laurenjaneimages

The Insider Guide to a Weekend in Newcastle

POV: You and your gal pals live in Sydney and don’t want to spend more than 2 hours in the car to reach your weekend getaway.

Where do you go? You head north on the pacific highway to reach the next largest coastal city outside of inner and outer Sydney! A weekend in Newcastle is the perfect combination for getting that refresh you so well need, a smaller representation of Sydney’s Northern Beaches with its beach side kiosks, surf-clubs and bars, all whilst being a stones throw from home (when you’re heading back on a Sunday and refuse to sit in traffic!)

Friday:

So, naturally, you leave first thing after you’ve closed your laptop for the day, cause why not! you’ll get there by dinner time - and that means you get to wake up in your getaway abode on Saturday morning. We’re all about getting that extra time!

WHERE TO STAY: Depending on where you’re wanting to stay, we have our three Newcastle packages where you can reside at the elegant Kingsley Hotel or the contemporary Quest hotels. These hotel choices do not disappoint, and situate you right in the middle of everything and its close to the harbour, and Nobby’s and Newcastle Beach!

EAT: For your first nights stay in Newcastle, we’ve handpicked an intimate dining space in the very heart of Newcastle East, that dips into the Novocastrian history, whilst raising a glass to it’s European threads. The land was previously known as the stonemason’s yard, ‘Lock’s Paddock’, hence the name of the now, bar and restaurant outlooking onto Watts street. From antique looking interior, to folk and country-western music being played throughout your dining experience, the Italian/Spanish restaurant & bar focuses on charcuterie, pork, gnocchi, smoked cheeses and everything in between! They even have an extensive wine list to pair with the foods on your dinner menu. There is two signature dishes which are a MUST TRY, and these are the Cacio e Pepe, served in a big cheese wheel, and our Carbonara.

Image Credit : lockspaddock.com.au

Image Credit: Undertow Snaps

Saturday:

Rise and Shine, the glorious beaches are harbour-side cafes of Newcastle are waiting for you! One interesting thing about Newcastle is that all of their beaches have a ‘Kiosk’ at their surfhouses where they serve takeaway coffee, breakfast and some lunch items from Nobby’s beach to Merewether beach. You could even mix it in with the must-do Newcastle coastal stroll and have your coffee at the banks of your choice of beach with the surf right in-front of you. Some say the Newy coastal beach walk with a coffee in hand is a rite of passage! ;) Signal Box on wharf road is also a nice spot for breakfast, lunch and dinner nestled between the harbour and the tram lines in Newcastle East.

Fancy a shop or browse after brunch? Hit up the bustling, yet hipster street on Darby, where you’ll find most things from op shops, book shops, men & women’s fashion stores, gifts and homewares, cafes, bars and restaurants. You’ll hear me refer back to Darby street when I get to the places to eat and drink at night time!

If it’s warm (or cold if you’re daring!) There are some great swim spots along the beaches and baths stretching from Nobby’s in the north, and Burwood in the south. Nestled between Bar beach and Merewether is where you’ll find Dixon. Dixon is a great swimming spot and alot less crowed than the usual Newcastle or Nobby’s beach. Another secret spot is Burwood, south of Merewether baths. This beach is completely secluded and private BUT it is a fair walk so be warned and plan ahead. P.S swimmers! The baths at Merewether get emptied and cleaned on Thursdays, and the Newcastle Baths get emptied and cleaned on Wednesdays.

Image Credit: https://www.derivedesign.com.au/newcastle-signal-box

Now when it comes to nightlife, eateries or places where theres a night-time vibe, you have four different main areas of Newcastle where you can’t go wrong.

EAT:

  1. Ginger Megs - King Street.

Enjoy Asian-Fusion? Ginger Megs draws inspiration from the array of Asian flavours, spices and ingredients native to South-East Asia. Fiery, colourful, bold and ambrosial; saturate your senses in an epicurean experience of epic proportions. To the right of Foghorn brewery you see this dark alleyway with orange neon lights surrounding a big double door. So intrigued you head inside and are immediately guided upstairs by a grand staircase and LED lights coming from each step. Once you reach the top, you enter South-East Asia.

This place is A-MAZING. Not only do they have a a great bar with yummy drinks, Yum Cha, a delicious array of meals to share on their menu, they also have a banquet feed for $60PP which is a must-try for you foodies. I hear they also do a bottomless brunch. Bottoms up ladies!

2. Antajitos - Steel Street, Newcastle West

The Mexican/Spanish translation for street food, or little cravings, is Antojitos. And in Steel Street, Newcastle West you’ll discover Newcastle’s very own Antojitos, a tasty diner that’s bursting with authentic and traditional Mexican street food flavours.

This place if for all the Mexican food-lovers - We’re talking Mexican street food in a big food hall, off the back of a busy kitchen with the most authentic experience of a Californian-style taqueria. It’s very casual dining, it’s very social, it’s very simple, it’s very affordable and best of all - It’s incredible food that tastes even better than it sounds.

Image Credit: HunterHunter

3. Scotties - Scott St, Newcastle East

Seafood, beers and Cocktails just moments from Newcastle Beach! I first stumbled across this quaint little restaurant on the side of the road by noticing the festoon lights attached to palm trees and outdoor seating in what looked like a small reserve between two streets. When I first tried it, I knew why it was so popular and successful.

Imagine sitting under the festoon lights on a balmy summer evening with a glass of wine a plate of some of Newcastles best seafood, whilst getting hit with a fresh sea breeze? Sounds idyllic doesn’t it?

Scotties is undeniably an icon in Newcastle East, and the East End, we all have memories of hot Summer afternoons enjoying some fish 'n chips or a burger after a swim at Newcastle Beach. Although Scotties is still etched into most Novocastrian’s memories as that fish n' chip shop near Newcastle Beach, it's actually matured into much more than that .Scotties is all about serving up sustainably caught fish, sourced predominately from local fisherman (where possible), their fish menu changes weekly depending on what's in season, plentiful and running at the time.


Image Credit- Scotties & HunterHunter.com

There’s no shortage of great pubs and bars around Newcastle, and theres definitely a fair few I could mention but it would make this blog way too long! Maybe I should write another blog about Newcastle Nightlife? hmm….

Earp Distillery - Carrington

And last BUT certainly not least (potentially my favourite) Earp Distilling Co. tucked away in the harbour-side haven of Carrington. The Tasting Bar is a stylish alternative to traditional pubs and bars, offering views directly into the working distillery. With a seasonal food and cocktail menu, Earp Distilling Co. spirits are offered as tastings or by the glass. You can also experience a guided spirit tasting, distillery tour, gin blending class or a Gin School class where you become a distiller for a day. Learning about the distilling process, select botanicals and take 'cuts' during your distillation to craft your very own bottle of gin. Venturing to Earp distillery is definitely an amazing experience from start to finish. With the help of the friendly staff, they offer you their knowledgeable recommendations as soon as you’re seated, and make sure you always a board in front of you so that you always have something to graze on!

Image Credit: Earp Distillery.

Make sure you also check out these areas if you’re looking for a place after Earp!

Carrington : Young Street Hotel Merewether: Merewether Surfhouse Darby Street; 5 Sawyers, Bar Romeo East End: Babylon, Coal & Cedar, Uptowns Bar

Sunday:

You’ve wined & dined, you’ve beached and shopped, but you can’t go home without experiencing breakfast at one of the many cafe choices in Newcastle.

Autumn Rooms - Darby St.

The Autumn Rooms is a cafe nestled in the heart of Darby Street, Cooks Hill. Their focus is on friendly and efficient customer service with excellent food, coffee and tea. This cafe is so beautifully designed with a delicate mix of antique intorior and and natural decor. With an extensive collection of teas, fresh baked scones and savouries - you’ll find yourself settling into long conversations with your girlfriends in no time.

A sparkling high tea is among one of our favourite things to experience here at Autumn rooms if you want to add a little bubbles to your brunch! We also offer it as an inclusion in our Coastal Escape package.

Image Credit: @Autumnrooms

Lauren

Girls Getaways xx

title: A Weekend Guide to Port Stephens
excerpt: If you’ve ever visited Port Stephens, you know just how magical it is, and if you haven’t experienced it yet, here’s why a girl’s getaway there should be at the top of your bucket list.
body:
Our Guide to a Weekend in Port Stephens, NSW.

If you’ve ever visited Port Stephens, you know just how magical it is, and if you haven’t experienced it yet, here’s why a girl’s getaway there should be at the top of your bucket list.

A short 2 and a half-hour drive will transport you from the hustle and bustle of everyday life to the laid-back lifestyle of Port Stephens. A hidden gem, Port Stephens is the perfect location for a relaxing girl's getaway. Gather your closest gal pals and scroll through our range of Port Stephens packages linked here. We are sure one will tickle your fancy.

Port Stephens boasts stunning beaches with pristine water, rolling sand dunes, coastal walks and a fabulous selection of restaurants and cafés that are a must-try when visiting. We have curated the perfect guide to a weekend in Port Stephens, filled with our top recommendations for eating, drinking, and unwinding. Enjoy…

MUST-TRY RESTAURANTS

  1. SHOAL BAY COUNTRY CLUB

Offering breakfast, lunch and dinner, Shoal Bay Country Club is the perfect place to take some time out and enjoy great food, great drinks, and great company. SBCC offers a range of delicious food located right in the heart of Shoal Bay. Its upstairs section boasts stunning waterfront views that are unbeatable so take a seat and enjoy the good food and great views!

Credit: Shoal Bay Country Club

2. RICK STEIN AT BANNISTERS

A must-try when visiting Port Stephens is Rick Stein at Bannisters. A well-known restaurant across Australia (and for good reason), Rick Stein’s menu consists of incredible seafood that is sourced from the area daily. The chefs keep dishes simple by choosing ingredients that naturally emphasise fresh seafood produce. Executed to perfection, each dish delivers bursts of flavour and is a restaurant you will never forget!

Credit: Rick Stein at Bannisters

3. TYNAN WINES

Our third recommendation for your getaway in Port Stephens is a visit to Tynan Wines, a stunning Artisan winery and cellar door founded by a lovely local couple. They are known for their wide range of delicious wines, with the grapes sourced from all over regional New South Wales. You can book a wine tasting online and are bound to have a fabulous time.

Credit: Food & Wine Magazine

MUST-TRY ACTIVITIES

Although eating and drinking is a crucial part of any girl’s getaway, for those ladies who love to get out and about we have listed below the best 3 activities to keep you on your toes!

  1. TOMAREE HEAD SUMMIT WALK

The first recommendation we have for you is the Tomaree Head Summit Walk. Only a 30-40 minute (but challenging!) walk, this scenic hike allows you to take in all the views Port Stephens has to offer. You will enjoy unparalleled views of Port Stephens and its coastline, seeing as far as Cabbage Tree and Boondelbah islands. Take some binoculars because if you’re lucky, you may even see some dolphins!

Credit: Concrete Playground

2. STOCKTON SAND DUNES

Whilst staying in Port Stephens, visiting the Stockton Sand Dunes is a must! These dunes are the largest moving coastal dunes in the Southern Hemisphere and cover approximately 4,200 hectares. Reaching up to 30 metres in height and 60 degrees, they are perfect for activities such as sandboarding! As well as sandboarding there are numerous camel, quad biking and 4-wheel driving tours available, allowing you to take in all the dunes have to offer.

Credit: Visit NSW

3. WATER CRUISE

Our last, but certainly not least recommendation is a water cruise giving you and your girls the opportunity to spot dolphins or whales. With over 140 bottlenose dolphins calling Port Stephens home, it’s no surprise these friendly locals are sighted so often. If you’re really brave you can even swim with the dolphins, which would be an unforgettable experience, just like being part of their pod!

If you’re looking to enjoy a water cruise whilst in Port Stephens then these are the companies we recommend!

  1. Moonshadow Cruises.

  2. Blue Water Tours.

Credit: Great Sights

Happy holidaying!

Love, the GG Team xx

body:
Guide to Noosa, QLD.

If you and your girls are dreaming of a blissful beach break, look no further than our popular Noosa getaways linked here. Located in Queensland’s Sunshine Coast, Noosa is the perfect spot to enjoy the beach, brunch and of course lots of bubbles.

We have put together a fabulous guide to Noosa, highlighting all it has to offer and why we love it! We must say though, Hastings Street is your one-stop-shop for our recommendations - lined with gorgeous fairy lights, ice cream shops, boutiques and much, much more.

Below you’ll find our top food favourites as well as some activities to keep you on your toes!

MUST-TRY RESTAURANTS

1. NOOSA BOATHOUSE

An idyllic waterfront location with a menu that lets seasonal produce shine, Noosa Boathouse is an iconic bistro, bar & events destination that truly encapsulates the relaxed Noosa lifestyle. We recommend a booking at the Sunset Bar on the top deck to enjoy the best sunset views in town (with a cocktail in hand of course).

Credit: Tourism and Events Queensland

2. MISS MONEYPENNYS

If you’re looking for a sophisticated restaurant/bar while visiting Noosa, reserve a table at Miss Moneypenny’s. Located on Hastings Street, Miss Moneypenny’s is a stylish venue with a relaxed atmosphere, offering a wide range of delicious cocktails alongside a modern Mediterranean cuisine. Miss Moneypenny’s has fast become an iconic place to visit for both locals and tourists, receiving several prestigious wins and nominations every year! They even have a dog-friendly deck so you can bring your furry friends.

Credit: Tourism and Events Queensland

3. BISTRO C

Another top pick when visiting Noosa is Bistro C, an elegant beachfront restaurant right in the heart of it all. Take in the view of Noosa Main Beach & indulge in their hand-crafted menu inspired by amazing local produce. Their relaxed, light filled space offers the perfect setting for a leisurely breakfast, long lunch, afternoon cocktail or moonlit dinner. Bistro C prides themselves on their passion for food which is evident in their award-winning cuisine.

Credit: Tourism and Events Queensland

4. BANG BANG

Bang Bang Noosa sits in the heart of Hastings Street, showcasing Southeast Asian Cuisine and a sharing-style menu like their hugely successful sister restaurant in Byron Bay. Exotic chandeliers hang from high ceilings, the dining area is set around an open kitchen and bar where signature cocktails flow. Dim lighting and lush greenery offer a tranquil setting; the ambience and the relaxed vibe feel quintessentially Noosa.

Credit: Bang Bang Restaurants

5. NOOSA HEADS SURF CLUB

If you are after a more laid-back lunch or dinner venue, then look no further than Noosa Heads surf club. Set right on Noosa Main Beach, they offer classic tasty pub food with a stunning view of the surf break. Enjoy a drink on their outside deck as the sun sets on the horizon and make sure to take lots of photos!

Credit: The Courier Mail

6. ROCOCO NOOSA

Our last food recommendation is Rococo Bistro on Hastings Street. This Italian restaurant is perfect for a light lunch and a cocktail! In the warmer months, take advantage of the outdoor seating while watching the foot traffic waltz by. At night, sit back & relax to the lively tunes from their resident DJ.

Credit: Rococo Noosa

7. MASSIMO’S GELATARIA

We decided to throw in a bonus recommendation for those who like something sweet! Massimo’s Gelateria is a must try for the best ice cream in town.

Credit: Tourism and Events Queensland

MUST-TRY ACTIVITIES

1. COASTAL WALKING TRACK

If you ask anyone what there is to do in Noosa, we can guarantee they will mention the coastal walk through the National Park, and for good reason! Approximately a 1 hour walk, this coastal route stretches 4.8 kilometres, with numerous little bays, photo opportunities and even wild koala’s to spot (yes you heard me right). Pack your water, snacks, swimmers and enjoy the sights. If you’re there at the right time of year, whale and dolphin sightings aren’t uncommon, so keep your eyes peeled. At the end of the walk, you will find yourself at the entrance to ‘Hells Gates,’ a renowned scenic cliff spot with 270-degree views!

Credit: Joint TA/TEQ

2. STAND-UP PADDLE BOARD

Hiring a stand-up paddle board is a fun activity that will keep you entertained for hours. Noosa main beach is the perfect place to practice your skills, with Noosa Stand Up Paddle or SUP Noosa being the best places to hire from. Enjoy!

Credit: Tourism and Events Queensland

3. SUNSET RIVER CRUISE

As we previously mentioned, Noosa is notorious for whale, dolphin and even turtle sightings, so a sunset cruise down the river might be the activity for you. Our top 2 recommendations are the Noosa Queen River Cruises or Noosa Ferry & Cruise Company. You will enjoy a beautiful boat ride, with a beverage, the sunset and hopefully some fauna to keep you company!

Credit: Tourism and Events Queensland

4. EUMUNDI MARKETS

While in Noosa, you must experience the world famous Eumundi Markets. A short 20-minute drive from Noosa main beach, these markets are on every Wednesday and Saturday, and have been since 1979! These open-air markets showcase over 600 stalls, ranging from food, fashion, flora and much more.

Credit: Tourism and Events Queensland

5. EXPLORE NOOSA MAIN BEACH

If you’re on the hunt for a quiet activity to end the day with, a simple stroll down the Noosa main beach boardwalk is always a good idea. Take your surfboard, beach towel, paddle board, or just yourself and have a quick dip in the big blue.

Credit: Tourism and Events Queensland

6. HASTINGS STREET SHOPPING

Hastings Street buzzes from coffee carts at sunrise to fairy-lit strolls at dinner. One of Australia's most iconic shopping precincts, along the pretty stretch of Hastings St, you'll find boutiques offering unique Noosa-born labels, international designers, high-end designer jewellery, organic beauty products, beautiful homewares and more.

Credit: Tourism and Events Queensland

Happy adventuring!

Love, the GG Team xx

body:

Our top 5 bar recommendations when visiting Melbourne

A girl’s weekend in Melbourne is always a good idea, whether it’s for a birthday, a hen’s celebration or just to spend some quality time with your gal pals!

If you love the hustle and bustle of a big city, look no further than our Melbourne packages here. Filled with pampering, brunch and bubbles, these packages range from one to two-night stays and are organised by the Girls Getaways team, meaning all you must do, is enjoy yourself!

If you find yourself with a spare afternoon on your hands and want to enjoy a drink but don’t know where to go, then this blog is for you!

1. ROMEO LANE

This bar will provide you with the perfect balance of class and comfort. An old-fashioned bar, only a stone’s throw from Chinatown, Romeo Lane is in a fabulous location, boasting a large fireplace and cocktails presented in beautifully cut glassware. With an impeccable drinks list, Romeo Lane has a catalogue of recipes up their sleeve, so all you need do is list your favourite ingredients and they will create something delicious just for you.

Credit: Romeo Lane

2. ARBORY AFLOAT

This seasonal floating bar on the gorgeous Yarra River is perfect for an afternoon on the water, with the sun shining and a refreshing cocktail in your hand. Founded by Turkish siblings Nada Thomas and Salim Gafayri, this bar offers a delicious menu of classic and contemporary Turkish dishes, complimented by a sublime list of wines and cocktails. The laidback chic vibe will transport you to the exotic Turquoise Coast in Turkey, offering a vibrant inner-city oasis.

Credit: Visit Victoria / Robert Blackburn

3. BAR LIBERTY

Tucked away in Fitzroy, this wine bar offers a carefully curated menu filled with wine, cider, cocktails, and whisky, with the variety and quality hard to beat! The venue is stripped back and quietly chic, paired with a sophisticated food menu that should not be overlooked. The best way to get a taste for it all? The $70pp set menu.

Credit: Visit Victoria / Josie Withers

4. BAR MARGAUX

You will find Bar Margaux right in Melbourne’s CBD. A take on a New York version of a Parisian bistro, which ticks all the right design tropes; a chequerboard floor, shiny white subway tiles, booths, wired glass dividers and golden back bar lighting. Offering food and drinks, Bar Margaux is known for their ‘Golden Hour’ specials, (between 4 and 6pm, and then again between midnight and close), and the continuous flow of traffic, keeping the energy high.

Credit: Visit Victoria / Ain Raadik

5. BAD FRANKIE

The last of our recommendations, Bad Frankie. A fabulous cocktail bar in Fitzroy stocking only Australian spirits and has been on the native train for years! Bad Frankie is a true-blue Aussie bar that puts jaffles, community sporting trophies and smart spirits utilising native ingredients next to each other.

Credit: Visit Victoria / Ain Raadik

title: Your Guide to Road Tripping on the NSW South Coast
excerpt: If you’ve been thinking about heading down South with your girlfriends for a getaway, look no further, we have the perfect road-trip guide that will ensure you don’t miss a thing! With white-sand…
body:
Your guide to road tripping on the NSW South Coast

If you’ve been thinking about heading down South with your girlfriends for a getaway, look no further, we have the perfect road-trip guide that will ensure you don’t miss a thing! With white-sand beaches, crystal clear water, relaxed coastal towns and stunning boutique wineries, it’s easy to fall in love with the South Coast of NSW. As this beautiful coastline becomes increasingly popular, we’ve focused on growing our incredible range of getaway packages, to make sure we have something to suit every girl group.

We know it can be difficult planning a road trip, so to make it easy for you, we’ve summarised our favourite places to stay, eat and explore on the South Coast!

KIAMA

  • STAY

Kiama is home to an abundance of beautiful beach homes, but our favourite has to be Bask at Loves Bay. Featured in ourSunrays & Sea Haze package, this luxury abode boasts stunning ocean views, a dreamy coastal vibe, and sun-drenched living spaces. For smaller group sizes, our brand newBikinis & Martinis package is perfect for you! Stay in a private beachside apartment with spacious living and dining areas flowing effortlessly to an outdoor entertaining balcony where you can soak up the ocean views and relax with a glass of bubbly.

  • EAT

For the best coffee and breakfast food in Kiama, you can’t go pastPenny Whilster’s orWild Patch Cafe. For dinner, overlook the sea atSilica Restaurant, Kiama's freshest local seafood and finest dining experience.

  • EXPLORE

Renowned as the town “where the sea makes a noise”, the Kiama blowhole is a must-visit. Being the largest blowhole in the world, when there is swell expect to see water reaching over 30 meters in height! If you’re looking to get in some exercise, take on the Kiama Coast Walk stretching from the mouth of the Minnamurra River through to Werri Beach in Gerringong. On your journey, you’ll be amazed by the rolling green hills, rugged cliffs and breathtaking views along the coastline.

Credit: Destination NSW

GERRINGONG / GERROA

  • STAY

Gerringong & Gerroa are the perfect coastal holiday destinations with a range of beautiful homes waiting for you to visit. Some of our all-time favourites are featured in our Glamour, Glow & Gourmet package, Shorelines & Grapevines package, and Good Times in Gerroa package. These luxe homes offer beautifully-styled spacious living and sleeping areas perfect for ladies looking to destress and indulge in some girl time.

  • EAT

Wine & dine at The Hill Bar and Kitchen or Gather by the Hill overlooking the gorgeous Werri Beach. Within walking distance from your Gerroa accommodation or just a short drive from Gerringong, dine at The Blue Swimmer for delicious breakfast, lunch & dinner. For our ladies who love a wine (or two), don’t forget to visit Crooked River Wines where you can enjoy a divine lunch overlooking the vineyards!

  • EXPLORE

Stop by The Kalm Store in Gerringong for gorgeous clothing, homewares and accessories & remember to mention that you’re on a girls getaway so you can receive 10% off! For our outdoorsy girls, set up for a day in the sun at Werri Beach or take on the Kiama coastal walk where you’ll see spectacular views along the coastline.

Credit: Eat Read Love (Natalie Hallyer)

BERRY

  • STAY

With a charming main street, award-winning restaurants and cafes, and lush landscape, it’s easy to fall in love with Berry. For your next visit, stay at the spectacular Berry Lake House featured in our Livin’ Lakeside package. Offering a private lake, modern appliances, wood-burning fireplace, outdoor fire pit and, and beautiful furnishings, this property is idyllic for girl groups seeking a luxe escape from the hustle and bustle.

  • EAT

Berry is known as a foodie’s paradise and offers a flavour-filled journey of locally made gourmet products. Some of our most-loved restaurants and cafes include Queen St Eatery, The Garden Berry, South on Albany, Milkwood Bakery, The Donut Man, and the Treat Factory.

  • EXPLORE

It’s easy to lose track of time in Berry – simply strolling down the bustling main street you’ll pass incredible buskers, unique boutiques, quirky cafes, fine-dining restaurants and heritage buildings. For our ladies looking to indulge, be pampered by the team at Blow Bar on Queen where you’ll receive a relaxed drink and an amazing blow-dry and style.

Credit: Supercalla Private Properties

CULBURRA / CURRARONG

  • STAY

Situated in the beautiful Shoalhaven region, Culburra Beach is surrounded by a river, lake, ocean and national park, making it the ultimate destination to unwind by the water. Here, stay at Silvermere Coastal Retreat on our Cool, Calm & Coastal package just steps away from Culburra Beach. If you’re looking for a rural oasis known for its stunning interiors and elegance, then our Country Farm & Coastal Charm package would suit you. Nearby in Currarong, stay at the incredible waterfront home Ocean Essence found in our Footsteps to the Sea package with private creek access that allows you to literally step out of your back doorstep onto the creek front! A weekend escape to this region will guarantee relaxed coastal towns, sparkling blue waterways, and plenty of wine time with your besties.

  • EAT

When in Culburra be sure to visit Loco Lane Mexican Cantina & Cocktail Bar for great Mexican food, cocktails, craft beers and good times!

  • EXPLORE

There are plenty of nearby beaches to explore, as well as places to picnic, snorkel and paddleboard. We also recommend travelling to picturesque Honeymoon Bay for a perfect day by the sea.

Credit: Ben Mack

CALLALA BEACH

  • STAY

If you’re looking for five-star waterfront accommodation, we have the perfect places for you! Stay at the breathtaking beach houses Atra (featured in our Jewel in Jervis Bay package) and Shearwater (featured in our Waterfront Wow Factor package), both in prime position on Callala Beach with incredible ocean views, open-plan living and sleeping areas, and an unmatched tranquil ambience. Just around the corner in Callala Bay we also recommend Mandala Beach House, a recently renovated luxe property, used in our Sands of the Soul package, with expansive views across Jervis Bay. These properties will truly make you feel like you’re in paradise.

  • EAT

The Butter Factory Restaurant in Pyree is a South Coast gem, located in the heart of the dairy country. Rich with character and history, here you’ll enjoy rustic and seasonal country dishes made with local produce, and enhanced with many homemade delights!

  • EXPLORE

This region is an ocean-lovers paradise, so in your downtime take up the opportunity to enjoy swimming, snorkelling, beach and bush walks, kayaking, paddle boarding and wildlife spotting (look out for dolphins commonly seen surfing the waves). Don’t forget to also make the most of the soft white sands with morning beach walks.

Credit: Supercalla Private Properties

VINCENTIA / HUSKISSON

  • STAY

In the heart of Jervis Bay, both Huskisson and Vincentia are vibrant coastal towns famous for their natural beauty - your girls weekend here will be filled with white sand beaches and crystal clear waters! Stay at Beachstone or Bethany Beach House for relaxed luxury vibes and open plan living, dining and kitchen spaces.

  • EAT

For delicious eats, we recommend visiting the Pavilion Bar & Kitchen at Huskisson Hotel for the best local produce and seafood from the South Coast, dining amongst the treetops at The Gunyah Restaurant at Paperbark Camp, or enjoying delicious food and drinks at Wildginger Huskisson, a South-East Asian restaurant & wine bar.

  • EXPLORE

With white-sand beaches, crystal clear water, laid-back coastal towns and an abundance of wildlife, you won’t be disappointed here in Vincentia & Huskisson. We recommend stopping by Blenheim, Chinamans & Hyams beaches - perfect for swimming, snorkelling and stand-up paddle boarding. If you have spare time, explore Jervis Bay National Park and nearby towns such as Berry & Callala Beach/Bay!

Credit: Supercalla Private Properties

MOLLYMOOK / MILTON

  • STAY

With beautiful beaches, endless ocean views, and fabulous dining experiences, you’re sure to love a girls getaway in Mollymook. For your seaside escape, look no further than our Ocean Gaze & Beach Days package, featuring a spectacular 3 bedroom house with panoramic views of North Mollymook beach. Plus, be sure to keep your eye out for our new Mollymook packages coming soon!

Just a short 7-minute drive from Mollymook is the gorgeous town of Milton, an elegant country town famous for its colourful shopping, art galleries, gourmet experiences, heritage streetscapes, and picture-postcard scenes. Stay at Woodstock Homestead on our Misty Mornings package, a luxurious retreat where you and your best girls will wake to spectacular sunrises over the countryside.

  • EAT

When it comes to dining in Mollymook & Milton there are so manly incredible places for you to choose from! Some of the GG favourites include Bannisters Pool Bar, Bannisters Rooftop Bar & Grill, Cupitt’s Estate, GWYLO, Milk Haus, Small Town Food + Wine.

  • EXPLORE

The incredible coastline offers plenty of areas to explore including Mollymook Beach, Narrawallee, Colliers Beach & more. Don’t forget to also stroll through the main street of Milton, where you can stop by cute cafes, boutiques, art galleries and surf shops.

Credit: Destination NSW

Five ideas for your next girls weekend in Canberra

Have you heard the news? We’ve launched in the ACT! Which means, planning a girls weekend in Canberra just got a whole lot easier. Whether you’re looking to celebrate a birthday, hens or much-needed catch-up with friends, our new Canberra packages, which range from exploring the picturesque wine regions to indulgent pampering and dining in some of the city’s most-loved venues, have you covered.

Suitable to both locals and tourists alike, these short getaways range from one- to two-night stays designed for (but not limited to) groups of up to 12 ladies. And it’s all organised for you by the Girls Getaways team.

So here they are, five ideas for your next girls weekend in Canberra:

1. CAPITAL CATCH-UPS

For ladies who love long lunches and city catch-ups:

  • Stay two nights at the contemporary Burbury Hotel, in the central precinct of Barton.

  • In the comfort of your luxury apartment, enjoy a grazing box delivered to your door featuring a variety of savoury nibbles and a hint of sweetness. Then, relax with a 30-minute in-house massage or facial (upgrade to 1-hour available).

  • Make your way to the beautiful grounds at Pialligo Estate (10 minutes from the city) and enjoy a three-course lunch in the winery’s beautiful dining spaces.
    + ADD ON: Transfers to and from your lunch.

VIEW PACKAGE

2. CLASSY IN CANBERRA

For ladies wanting a getaway that is as fun as it is stylish:

  • Stay two nights in a luxury apartment at Burbury Hotel, in the central precinct of Barton, Canberra

  • Celebrate with High Tea at The Tea Lounge in the Hyatt Hotel Canberra including a range of savouries and sweets and a glass of sparkling wine.

  • Then shake things up with a cocktail-making masterclass at The Highball Express bar where you’ll learn how to make three classic cocktails before getting behind the bar to make your own. And yes, you get to drink them after.

    + ADD ON: Grazing Platter delivered to your room.

VIEW PACKAGE

3. CITY SLICKING & WINE SIPPING

Uncover Canberra's wine region in style on a city-to-vineyard getaway:

  • Stay two nights in a luxury apartment at Burbury Hotel, in the central precinct of Barton, Canberra.

  • Catch up over a grazing box delivered to your room including a variety of savoury nibbles and a hint of sweetness.

  • Unwind with a 30-minute massage or facial in the comfort of your accommodation.

  • The next day, set off for a private tour of Canberra’s wine region, featuring visits to three cellar doors, a wood-fired pizza lunch and pick up and return to your accommodation.

    +UPGRADE to Stretch Limousine for your wine tour – recommended for hens and birthday groups (minimum of 8 Passengers)

4. GIRLS NIGHT IN

Plan the ultimate girls night in one of Canberra’s finest luxury hotels:

  • Celebrate with a bottle of chilled Moët & Chandon delivered to your room on arrival

  • Order in with a $30 credit towards your room service bill

  • Spend the night in luxurious bathrobes which are yours to take home

  • Make use of access to the on-site gym and indoor pool and complimentary undercover secure parking

    + ADD ON: 30-minute or 1-hour in-house massage or facial.

This luxe option is for ladies looking to relax and indulge:

  • Stay two nights in the 5-star apartment-style accommodation at Hotel Realm located next to the Parliamentary Triangle in the elegant suburb of Barton.

  • Indulge in a four-course dinner at one of Canberra’s award-winning fine dining restaurants (think The Boat House or Aubergine Restaurant)

  • The next day, unwind with a 1-hour pampering session at Jindii Eco Spa in the Australian National Botanic Gardens, consisting of a 30-minute massage and 30-minute facial.

    +Upgrade your spa package to include a grazing platter with sparkling wine and juice (minimum 6 people)
    Note: Due to the popularity of these inclusions, this package should be booked at least two months in advance.

excerpt: There’s nothing quite like spending time away with your closest girlfriends, catching up over a glass (or two) of wine, exploring a new place, and making memories that will last a lifetime. But…
body:
A step-by-step guide to organising your next girls weekend

There’s nothing quite like spending time away with your closest girlfriends, catching up over a glass (or two) of wine, exploring a new place, and making memories that will last a lifetime. But planning it… what a nightmare!

Here at GG, we understand that it’s difficult to manage work-life balance and find the motivation to get everything organised. That’s why we create all-inclusive packages that take away the stress of planning a fun weekend away with the girls!

So since we have all the smaller details taken care of, we just need you to decide on a getaway package that is suited to you and your friends! Here are a few things to consider:

RALLY THE TROOPS AND AGREE ON A BUDGET

Send out a text and get all the girls on board! Once you figure out how many people are keen to escape, indulge, and relax, you will all need to agree on a budget that everyone is happy with. We have a range of packages that vary in price, so check out our website and get some ideas.

ESTABLISH YOUR GETAWAY GOALS & SELECT THE PERFECT PACKAGE

Everyone has a different idea of a holiday, so it’s important to know what you and your girlfriends expect from a getaway. To get you thinking, here are a few things you may want to consider:

  • Coastal or Country

  • Explore or Relax

  • Pool or Beach

  • Spa Retreat or Wine Tour

Once you establish your getaway goals, it will be easy for you to select your ultimate GG package!

COUNTRY FARM & COASTAL CHARM

PACK YOUR ESSENTIALS

When it comes to packing for a girls getaway, we’ve all experienced that rush the night before where you have piles of clothes laid out on your bed and you can’t decide what to take. To help you out, we noted a few essentials to add to your bag:

  • Clay face masks

  • Swimmers & sunglasses

  • Camera

  • Board games and/or cards

  • A fancy frock

  • Snacks & wine!

PLAN YOUR ROADTRIP & GET EXCITED!

Remember to enjoy the journey just as much as the destination! Make sure you all secure a spot in the car, download a fire playlist for the drive, and plan some fun stopovers. Headed to Mollymook? Stopover in Jervis Bay to explore white-sand beaches and turquoise waters. Traveling to Orange? Visit Milthorpe to discover boutique cellar doors and cute cafes. Driving to Noosa? Check out the beautiful Mooloolaba on the way.

So gather the girls and don’t stress! Enquire via our website to book your dream girls getaway.
